description: Gate A §8.4: a jar has come off the belt. The conveyor fires this the moment one goes over — the module owns the falling jar, this owns the BEAT, which is why the clean-up is authored here in seconds rather than buried in a timer. Option (a) of the two Josh put at Gate A: the feed's own interference covers the cut, and the floor is clean on the other side. Nothing here is shared state — a knocked-off jar is a local response, and this event never reaches the scheduler.
